entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm in paradise...!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Honestly, I wanna live here.[n]Wait, there are tons of people...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But, but... all of this still gets[n]me excited! Seeing it in person is[n]way different than images online!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Come on, let's go check out that[n]extra-thin laptop everyone's been[n]talking about lately!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was definitely thin,[n]but still disappointing...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They said it was "full of[n]functions," but I'm not[n]really seeing it...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...I don't care anymore.[n]Do you understand how I feel?
Don't you already have a PC?
It's too bad.
You feel betrayed...[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You sound like Sojiro.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's not like I was gonna buy[n]it. I just wanted to get excited[n]about the future of electronics...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You get it...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They totally betrayed[n]what I expected from the[n]evolution of electronics.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's right! They betrayed me!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I had super high expectations for[n]what the evolution of electronics[n]was gonna look like...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But all I saw there was[n]an empty slab of metal.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh well. There's no point[n]in getting depressed over it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's still gotta be some[n]unseen treasure waiting for me[n]in this electronic paradise!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Let's go explore, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We'll start on the underground[n]floor! To the escalatorrrrrr!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Man, this is cool no matter[n]how many times I look at it!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I already have three of them[n]though, so you can have it,[n][fName]. It's a present!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't wanna go home... Let[n]me stay in my paradise...
